data.gender_notes: Pramod is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Pramod means 'moving forward' or 'progress'. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'pramoda', which signifies overcoming difficulties and making progress in life. It is a powerful name that embodies the spirit of courage, determination, and optimism. The name Pramod carries the meaning “Moving forward, progress” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Pramod usually hope their child will grow to embody moving forward, progress and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Embracing change and progress with courage and determination.
data.etymology: Pramod belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Moving forward, progress.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Pramod total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

It represents the constant striving to move forward on the path of knowledge and understanding, overcoming the challenges of the material world. historical_references.reference: Pramod was a famous wrestler from the medieval Indian kingdom of Haihaiyakathaka, modern day Andhra Pradesh. He was also known as 'Chaturbhuja Pramod' due to his four arms, which was a divine gift. Pramod's wrestling skills were legendary and he was considered invincible in his time.

Pramod Shastri was a renowned Sanskrit scholar, philosopher, and poet from ancient India around the 1st century BCE. He is most famous for his work 'Pramodavrittika', which is a commentary on the 'Mahabharata'. Pramod's work is considered a valuable contribution to the study of Sanskrit literature and Indian philosophy.
